name: Takatsukasa
source:
Candidate for the first Seishitsu room, both literary and martial arts.
Although he is from the five regents and has a high status, he behaves freely without feeling it.
He seems to be reluctant to become a regular room because he has a bad relationship with Iemitsu ...?

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/shinooku/chara/takatsukasa.html]official website[/url]]
